title: Mastawesha
description: Mastawesha is a podcast the presents the story of legendary artists and peoples from Ethiopia. Enjoy our weekly podcast and follow our channel on different platforms.

episodes.title: Muluken Melesse - ሙሉቀን መለሰ
episodes.description: In this episode, we pay tribute to the legendary Ethiopian artist Muluken Melesse, who passed away this year. We present an insightful interview originally aired on EBS Enchewawot program, offering a rare glimpse into the life and career of one of Ethiopia's most influential musicians. With full credit to the EBS team, we share this historical conversation to ensure the legacy and impact of Muluken Melesse is accessible to all. Join us as we celebrate his remarkable journey, his profound contributions to Ethiopian music, and the stories that have shaped his enduring legacy. This podcast is dedicated to preserving and sharing the history of Muluken Melesse and other Ethiopian artists for future generations.

episodes.title: Sami Dan Interview - ሳሚ ዳን
episodes.description: In this episode, we delve into the captivating world of Sami Dam, a young Ethiopian singer-songwriter whose music is making waves both locally and internationally. Hailing from the vibrant cultural landscape of Ethiopia, Sami Dam brings a fresh perspective to the music scene with his soulful melodies, poignant lyrics, and enchanting voice. Born and raised in Addis Ababa, Sami Dam's musical journey began at a young age, inspired by the rich musical heritage of his homeland. Drawing influences from traditional Ethiopian music, jazz, soul, and contemporary pop, Sami Dam crafts a unique sound that resonates deeply with audiences around the globe. Join us as we explore Sami Dam's rise to prominence, from his humble beginnings performing in local venues to gaining recognition on the international stage. We'll uncover the stories behind some of his most beloved songs, discussing the themes of love, identity, and social consciousness that permeate his music. Through insightful interviews and captivating music samples, listeners will gain a deeper appreciation for Sami Dam's artistry and the cultural tapestry that shapes his sound. Whether you're a long-time fan or discovering his music for the first time, this episode offers a compelling glimpse into the talent and vision of one of Ethiopia's brightest musical talents, Sami Dam.

episodes.title: Zerubabbel Molla - ዘሩባቤል ሞላ
episodes.description: In this episode of "Unveiling Creativity," we delve into the captivating journey of Zerubabbel Molla, a rising star in the Ethiopian art scene. Hailing from the vibrant city of Addis Ababa, Molla's artistry transcends boundaries, blending traditional Ethiopian motifs with contemporary flair. Born into a family of artists, Molla's passion for creativity was ignited at a young age. Inspired by the rich cultural tapestry of Ethiopia, he embarked on a quest to carve his own artistic identity, fusing elements of heritage and innovation in his work. Through his vibrant paintings and sculptures, Zeru explores themes of identity, belonging, and social consciousness, inviting viewers to ponder the complexities of the human experience. From bustling cityscapes to intimate portrayals of everyday life, his art serves as a powerful medium for storytelling and self-expression. Join us as we unravel the artistic odyssey of Zerubabbel Molla, celebrating his bold vision and enduring commitment to pushing the boundaries of Ethiopian artistry. Through his journey, we gain insight into the transformative power of creativity and the universal language it speaks.

episodes.title: Haile Gebrselassie Interview - ኀይሌ ገብረ ሥላሴ
episodes.description: In this episode, we delve into the remarkable journey of Haile Gebrselassie, one of the greatest long-distance runners of all time. From humble beginnings in rural Ethiopia to conquering the world stage, Gebrselassie's story is one of perseverance, dedication, and sheer talent. We explore his early struggles, including running barefoot to school, and how he discovered his passion for running. With unparalleled determination, Gebrselassie rose to prominence, breaking world records and dominating the track. But Gebrselassie's impact extends far beyond his athletic achievements. As a philanthropist and advocate for education, he has worked tirelessly to improve the lives of children in Ethiopia, building schools and providing opportunities for underprivileged youth. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of Haile Gebrselassie, a true inspiration on and off the track, whose story continues to inspire millions around the world.

Through insightful interviews and firsthand accounts, we delve into the driving forces behind Ermiyas's entrepreneurial endeavors, exploring the challenges he encountered and the strategies he employed to overcome them. episodes.title: Abegasu Kibrework Shiota Interview - አበጋዝ ሺዎታ
episodes.description: Join us on a captivating journey as we delve into the life and career of Abegasu Kibrework Shiota, a musical maestro whose roots span across continents. Born to a Japanese mother and Ethiopian father, Abegasu's upbringing intertwined the rich cultural tapestries of both nations. From his early days in Japan to his formative years in Ethiopia, and later his pursuit of musical excellence at the prestigious Berkeley College of Music in Boston, Abegasu's story is one of cultural fusion and artistic brilliance. In this episode, we explore how Abegasu's diverse background shaped his musical identity and influenced his approach as one of Ethiopian pop music's most sought-after producers. Through insightful interviews and captivating anecdotes, we uncover the inspirations behind his groundbreaking work and the challenges he faced in navigating the intersections of different cultural landscapes. From blending traditional Ethiopian melodies with contemporary beats to fostering cross-cultural collaborations, Abegasu's contributions to the music industry transcend boundaries and celebrate the beauty of diversity. Tune in as we celebrate the life and legacy of a visionary artist whose passion for music knows no borders.

episodes.title: ጌታቸው ካሣ - Getachew Kassa
episodes.description: Join us on a journey through the remarkable life and music of Getachew Kassa, one of Ethiopia's most celebrated musicians of the 20th century. Starting as a young talent playing at the iconic Patrice Lumumba Bar in Wube Berha, Kassa quickly made a name for himself with his soulful melodies and captivating performances. From his early days with Fetan Band to his collaborations with renowned groups like the Walias Band, Kassa's musical genius shone through in hits like "Addis Ababa" and "Tezata Slow". But Getachew's story extends far beyond the borders of Ethiopia. In 1981, he embarked on a new chapter, moving to the United States where he continued to spread his musical influence while advocating for the plight of his homeland. Despite facing challenges as an immigrant, his talent and passion persisted, leading to the release of his first CD in 1983 and subsequent collaborations with artists like Alemayehu Eshete. Through highs and lows, Kassa's commitment to his craft remained unwavering, culminating in the release of "The Best of Getachew Kassa" album in 2000, showcasing the brilliance of his extensive career. Join us as we explore the enduring legacy of this musical pioneer, whose journey from humble beginnings to international acclaim embodies the power of music to transcend boundaries and unite hearts across the globe.

episodes.title: Asfaw Meshesha interview and tribure_የአስፋው መሸሻ
episodes.description: Tribute to the late Asfaw Meshesha In this poignant memorial episode, "Unveiling Stories" pays tribute to the late Asfaw Meshesha, who passed away in January 2024. Born in 1967 during the Ethiopian Civil War, Asfaw's life unfolded against privilege and turmoil. As a member of the school debate team in Addis Ababa, he discovered his passion for rhetoric. In 1996, Asfaw's journey took him to the University of Missouri, where he pursued journalism on a scholarship. This episode serves as a heartfelt remembrance, unraveling the layers of Asfaw's life—from the echoes of war to the halls of academia. Join us in celebrating a life marked by resilience, passion, and an unwavering commitment to truth. As we bid farewell, we reflect on the indelible impact Asfaw Meshesha left on history and storytelling.

Kudos to Dereje Haile for his skilled journalism! We're thrilled to share this riveting conversation with you.
